canal_tick_measurements.interpretation: The short-spur limit is calibrated against manually traced known ruler ticks; repeated spacing and orientation are required before any spur is removed.

filter.threshold_basis: 5.8 px rounds up the measured 5.762 px maximum among 52 known canal ticks; matched residual spurs measured 0.652-5.345 px with a 3.655 px median.
filter.known_tick_matching: arm <= 1.25 px from a digitized tick, within 28 degrees of its axis, and junction <= 3 px from its canal centerline

official_12x_centerline_retrace.method: 12x official pure-river raster blue mask; national outline plus buffered current cross-border/seasonal corridors; ocean and known lake interiors removed; lake shoreline loops and dashed seasonal strokes excluded; outer tails of canal ruler ticks removed while retaining short stems for graph classification; repeated groups of at least three short, similarly oriented, regularly spaced perpendicular spurs are removed while isolated or paired short tributaries are retained; 3x3 one-pixel closing; tiled raster skeleton; graph traced at shared nodes; paths clipped to the national outline and simplified with endpoint-preserving 0.08 map-pixel tolerance.
